no_tags: No tags yet. Create your first tag.

merge_hint: All movements, recurring items, and starting balance will be transferred to the target source. The current source will be deleted.
merge_no_targets: No other accounts in this currency to merge into.

whim_confirm_purchase: Confirm purchase? An outgoing movement will be created.

saving_description_placeholder: e.g. Skipped eating out, cancelled subscription...
tags_page_subtitle: Categorize movements any way you like. Used for filtering and reports.
plugin_installed: Plugin installed. Restart required to activate.
mobile_nav_sidebar_desc: Slide-out sidebar menu on small screens
mobile_nav_bottom_desc: Fixed bottom navigation bar like mobile apps
ui_size_desc: Scales fonts, spacing and controls across the whole app
no_history_data: Not enough data points yet — refresh or update prices to start building history
menu_layout_desc: Show, hide and reorder items in the side menu. Mobile bottom nav is unaffected.
attachments_restart_for_native_picker: Restart Yfine to enable the native file picker
no_help_available: No help available for this page.
hotkeys_desc: Press the bound keys anywhere in the app to navigate. Skipped while typing in inputs.
hotkeys_capture_hint: Click a shortcut field and press the key combo. Backspace clears it (disables that action).
import_restart_notice: Some plugins will be installed or updated. A restart is required to fully activate them.
search_placeholder: Search anything… amounts, notes, sources, tags
search_hint_empty: Type at least 2 characters — try a note, an amount, or a date
attachments_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, PDF · max 10 MB · up to 5 files
attachments_drop: Drag files here or click to browse
saving_from_source_hint: The money is moved from this account into the per-currency savings fund.
goal_close_info: Closing "{{name}}" will move {{amt}} {{cur}} back to the selected account.
goal_delete_confirm: Delete this goal? Any allocated money is returned to where it came from.
goal_alloc_delete_confirm: Remove this allocation? The money goes back to the original account.
budget_delete_confirm: Delete this budget? Your movements are kept.
portfolio_delete_confirm: Delete this portfolio and all its holdings and price history? This cannot be undone.
holding_delete_confirm: Delete this holding and its price history? This cannot be undone.
goal_allocate_overdraft: {{src}} currently holds {{bal}}. Allocating {{amt}} will put it in the negative. Continue?
no_goals: No goals yet. Start your first one.
whim_purchase_goal_notice: You've already saved {{allocated}} {{currency}} — it will be used to pay for this.
wizard_intro: Yfine moved to a new savings model where money actually flows into a per-currency fund. We need to decide what to do with your existing savings log.
wizard_done: Done! Your savings are now live in the fund.
wizard_mode_movements: Import each entry as a historical contribution
wizard_mode_movements_desc: Creates a transfer for every past saving. Keeps full granularity.
wizard_mode_balance: Collapse into the fund's starting balance
wizard_mode_balance_desc: Adds the total amount as the fund's opening balance. Fastest, but you lose the per-entry history.
wizard_mode_discard_desc: Deletes every legacy saving entry. Can't be undone.
wizard_unified_source: Where did the money come from?
manage_funds_hint: Hide a fund to keep it out of the Accounts page while it still works as a regular source everywhere else.
welcome_step_1: Create your first source (e.g. Bank Account, Cash)
welcome_step_2: Record your income and expense movements
welcome_step_3: Set up recurring expenses so you never forget them
welcome_help_hint: Need help? Click the question mark in the top right on any page for a guide about that page.
whim_congrats_text: You achieved your goal. The movement has been recorded.
whim_achieved_footer: Keep achieving your goals so that your biggest hassle is having to scroll to the bottom of this page.
export_pdf_select_sections: Select what to include in your report
export_pdf_toc_sources: All your accounts and wallets with current balances
export_pdf_toc_movements: Income and expenses grouped by month with charts
export_pdf_toc_whims: Wish list with status and totals
lock_now_desc: Lock the app now — you'll need your password to unlock.
password_active_desc: Your database is encrypted and access requires authentication.
password_not_set_desc: Set a password to encrypt your database and protect access to Yfine.
password_guide_mix: Mix of uppercase and lowercase letters
password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
password_already_set: A password is already set. Use change instead.
password_set_success: Password set successfully. Restart to activate encryption.
password_removed_success: Password removed. Database is no longer encrypted.
password_restart_hint: Restart the application to activate database encryption.
remove_password_confirm: This will remove encryption and password protection. Are you sure?
login_decrypt_failed: Failed to decrypt the database. Please try again.
login_too_many: Too many login attempts. Try again in {{n}}s.
logs_desc: Download the log file for troubleshooting. Logs contain technical details about errors and operations.
reset_all_data_confirm_1: Do you want to delete all your data? This includes every source, movement, tag, recurring item, saving, wishlist entry, and notification.
reset_all_data_confirm_2: This action is irreversible. Your data cannot be recovered unless you have an export backup. Proceed?
clear_logs_confirm: Clear all log entries? This cannot be undone.
server_port_desc: Port used by the application. Restart required after change.
sessions_revoked: All sessions have been invalidated. Everyone must log in again.
portfolios_subtitle: Track stocks, crypto and ETFs with optional live prices.
no_portfolios: No portfolios yet. Create your first one to get started.
portfolio_base_currency_hint: Currency used to aggregate portfolio totals.
no_holdings: No holdings yet. Add your first one to see performance.
privacy_mode_desc: Use the eye button in the top bar to blur every amount across the app. Configure how it behaves below.
privacy_hover_reveal_desc: When on, hovering a blurred amount briefly shows it. Turn off to keep everything hidden until you disable privacy mode.
privacy_unlock_code_desc: Optional. When set, this code is required to turn privacy mode off. It's a soft on-screen lock, not encryption.
privacy_unlock_desc: Enter your code to show amounts again.
track_address_desc: Read the on-chain balance of a public wallet address — the quantity updates automatically on each price refresh.
qty_from_address: Synced from the address on refresh
manual_price_mode_hint: When on, you set the price by hand and automatic refresh is skipped.
prices_off_enable_link: Turn on live prices in Settings
prices_off_desc: Portfolios show cost basis only. Enable live prices to see market value and P/L.
portfolio_prices_on_desc: Yfine will contact CoinGecko (crypto) and Yahoo Finance (stocks) to refresh prices every 30 minutes.
portfolio_prices_off_desc: No external network calls. You can still enter manual prices for each holding.
tradingview_note: Charts by TradingView. The shown symbol may differ from your holding’s exchange — change it in the chart if needed.
portfolio_charts_on_desc: A chart button on each holding opens an embedded TradingView chart (loads content from tradingview.com).
portfolio_charts_off_desc: No external charts are loaded — enable to embed TradingView charts per holding (opt-in).
portfolio_prompt_desc: Yfine can follow your crypto and stock positions using CoinGecko and Yahoo Finance. This needs an internet connection and can be changed anytime.
portfolio_auto_refresh_info: Prices refresh automatically every 30 minutes; you can force a manual refresh with the button.
linked_source_hint: The portfolio belongs to this source; its market value is added to your net worth.
portfolio_needs_source: To create a portfolio you must first create a source (account/bank).
no_portfolios_in_source: No portfolios linked to this source yet.
source_has_portfolios_warning: This source has {{n}} portfolio(s) that will be deleted or moved.
cannot_make_external_with_portfolios: You cannot make a source external while it contains portfolios.
import_from_bank_desc: Import movements from a bank statement or an export from another app (CSV, OFX/QFX, XLSX). Data is added to an existing source without replacing anything.
import_drop_or_click: Drop a file here or click to select
import_supported_formats: Supported: CSV, OFX/QFX, XLSX — banks, YNAB, Firefly III, Revolut, N26 and more
import_duplicates_desc: Rows that look like duplicates of existing movements are highlighted. Tick the ones you want to import anyway.
import_no_source_selected: Select a source or create a new one
import_no_rows_selected: Select at least one row to import
import_mapping_desc: The file's columns are not recognized. Map each required field to a column.
import_map_need_min: Map a date column and either an amount or both in/out columns.
yield_hint: Set a return rate to automatically credit interest to this source every period (e.g. a savings or term-deposit account). Interest is calculated on the current cash balance and compounds. Leave the rate at 0 to disable.
budgets_hint: Set a spending limit on a tag and track it automatically each period.
alert_threshold_hint: Notify when spending reaches this percentage (0 = no alert).
rollover_hint: Carry the unspent surplus — or overspend — into the next period.
budgets_need_tags: Create at least one tag first to budget against.
transfer_no_rate: No exchange rate set — enter the amount manually
alert_insufficient: Warn me if the balance is too low
budgets_subtitle: Per-tag spending limits with live tracking.
bulk_tag_hint: Add appends, Remove strips, Replace sets exactly these tags.
calendar_hint: Pick a day with activity to see its movements.
confirm_delete_movement: This movement will be permanently deleted.
confirm_delete_transfer: This will remove both legs of the transfer.
del_all_desc: Remove this source and all its movements.
del_external_desc: Keep movements but detach them from any account.
del_move_desc: Reassign its movements to another account.
delete_saving_confirm: Delete this saving? The money is refunded to the source account.
delete_tag_used_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? It's on {{movements}} movement(s) and {{budgets}} budget(s) — those budgets will be removed and the tag dropped from every movement.
err_is_savings_pair: This is a savings deposit — edit it from the Savings page.
err_is_goal_allocation: This is a goal allocation — manage it from the Goals page.
err_fund_transfer_not_allowed: Transfers can't touch a savings fund — use Save/Withdraw instead.
err_fund_not_deletable: Savings funds can't be deleted — they hold your saved money.
export_hint: Download a full backup or a spreadsheet.
goal_fund_hint: Money accumulates in your savings fund for this currency.
goals_subtitle: Savings targets funded by real allocations.
merge_tag_hint: Move all {{n}} movements onto the target tag, then delete "{{name}}". This can't be undone.
missing_fx: Some holdings use a currency with no exchange rate — totals may be approximate.
not_enough_history: Not enough history to chart yet.
preview_db_note: Browser preview with seeded sample data.
recurring_subtitle: Bills, subscriptions and income on a schedule.
restore_confirm: Restoring replaces ALL current data. Continue?
restore_hint: Import a .yfine archive or JSON backup (replaces everything).
saving_fund_hint: Money moves into your savings fund for that currency — your net worth is unchanged.
savings_subtitle: Set money aside into a savings fund — conserving, not spending.
section_rebuilding: This section is being rebuilt in the new Yfine. It will be wired to your data in an upcoming phase.
sources_subtitle: Your accounts — balances are computed from movements.
tags_subtitle: Label movements to power budgets, filters, and reports.
vault_locked: Your data is encrypted. Enter your password to unlock.
whim_drain_hint: Your saved {{amt}} will be moved into the chosen account first.
whims_subtitle: A prioritised wishlist — save up or buy outright.
err_cross_currency: Both sources must share the same currency.
err_fund_save_rejected: You can't save from a savings fund.
err_not_a_fund: That source isn't a savings fund.
err_active_goal_blocks_delete: An active goal still uses this source.
err_has_portfolios: This source has portfolios — move or delete them first.
err_invalid_amount: Amount must be greater than zero.
err_is_transfer_leg: This is part of a transfer — edit it from the transfer form.
err_unknown_tag: One of the tags no longer exists.
err_duplicate_budget: An active budget for this tag and currency already exists.
err_invalid_currency: Unknown currency code. Use a valid ISO 4217 code.
err_alloc_from_own_source: You can't allocate from the goal's own fund.
err_close_to_own_source: Pick a different account to refund into — not the goal's own fund.
err_use_close_or_delete: Use Close (refund) or Delete to wind a goal down.
err_not_pending: Only pending items can do that.
err_not_dismissed: Only dismissed items can be restored.
err_duplicate_tag: A tag with that name already exists.
err_invalid_color: Color must be a hex code like #6366f1.
err_attachment_unsupported: Unsupported file type. Allowed: PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, PDF.
err_no_currency: Set a base currency in Settings to make this recurring.
err_fund_currency_locked: A savings fund's currency can't be changed — it is the fund for that currency.
err_active_goal_blocks_currency_change: An active goal saves into this account in its current currency — close or delete it first.
err_linked_goal_currency_locked: This whim has an active savings goal in its current currency — close or delete the goal first.
updates_hint: Yfine can check GitHub for new versions. This is the only feature that reaches the internet on its own — and only if you turn it on.
auto_update_desc: When on, Yfine quietly checks for a newer version each time it starts and notifies you if one is available. Off by default — and nothing ever installs without your confirmation.
updates_preview_note: Available in the installed app only.
update_offline: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
profile_separate_note: Each profile keeps its own separate database, password and settings — nothing is shared between profiles.
profile_delete_confirm: Delete “{{name}}” and ALL of its data (movements, sources, settings)? This cannot be undone.
profile_delete_active: Switch to another profile first to delete this one.
exchange_rates_desc: Needed to value multi-currency portfolios, the consolidated net worth and cross-currency transfers. A pair reads: 1 of the first currency = rate of the second. Missing pairs are derived from the ones you have (EUR→USD and EUR→GBP give you USD→GBP).
rates_source_hint: Fetches from the European Central Bank (frankfurter.app) and CoinGecko for crypto. Nothing is sent about you.
rates_unsupported: No provider quotes {{list}} — enter those by hand.
rates_offline: Couldn't reach the rate provider — your saved rates are unchanged.
invalid_rate: Enter a rate greater than 0 between two different currencies.
no_rates: No exchange rates yet — amounts in other currencies are left out of your totals. Add a pair below or fetch them online.
rates_none_needed: Nothing to convert — all your money is already in {{ccy}}.
touch_id_ready: Your Mac can store the app password in the Secure Enclave.
touch_id_needs_signing: Not available in this build. macOS only releases a fingerprint-protected secret to an app signed with an Apple Developer ID, and Yfine ships unsigned. Storing your password anywhere less protected would weaken the encryption it exists to provide, so it isn't offered.
touch_id_no_biometry: This Mac has no fingerprint enrolled.
tag_gross_hint: {{v}} counting every movement with this tag in full
multi_tag_split_hint: A movement with several tags splits its amount evenly between them, so the shares add up to 100%.
